introduce: Sit on a chair with your back straight. Slowly extend your left leg until it is straight and parallel to the ground, then slowly lower it down. Repeat the exercise.
name: OPEN CHAIN KNEE EXTENSION LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Do this exercise slowly and don't use the impulsive force.
Don't lean forward or backward during the exercise.

introduce: Sit on a chair with your back straight. Slowly extend your right leg until it is straight and parallel to the ground, then slowly lower it down. Repeat the exercise.
name: OPEN CHAIN KNEE EXTENSION RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.

introduce: Sit on a chair with your back straight. Slowly lift your left knee straight up, then slowly lower it down.
name: KNEE LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please do this exercise slowly and do not use the impulsive force.
Please don't lean forward or backward during the exercise.
This exercise strengthens your hip flexors.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.

introduce: Stand and hold a chair with your left hand to keep balance. \n\nLift your right leg to your right side as much as possible. Return and repeat.
name: RIGHT LEG LATERAL RAISE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your core.
Please keep your upper body still.
This exercise works the lateral muscles on your legs.

introduce: Stand and hold a chair with your right hand to keep balance. \n\nLift your left leg to your left side as much as possible. Return and repeat.
name: LEFT LEG LATERAL RAISE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your core.
Please keep your upper body still.
This exercise works the lateral muscles on your legs.

introduce:
Prepare a chair that is about the height of your knees, and put it directly behind you. 

Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, and stretch your arms straight forward. Then lower your body, and slowly sit into the chair. 

Squeeze your glutes, and go back to the standing posture. Repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR SQUATS

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If too easy for you, remove your chair.
You should feel your glutes burning.
This exercise can tone up your lower body.
This exercise targets your hips, thighs and glutes.

introduce: Sit on the edge of a chair with your back straight, extend your left leg in front of you with your heel on the ground, toes pointing up.\n\nReach both of your hands towards your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: SEATED HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your knee straight during the stretch.
Please keep the other foot flat on the ground.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Sit on the edge of a chair with your back straight, extend your right leg in front of you with your heel on the ground, toes pointing up.\n\nReach both of your hands towards your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: SEATED HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your knee straight during the stretch.
Please keep the other foot flat on the ground.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Sit on a chair. Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Hinge forward from the hips, using your left hand to push your knee down toward the ground. 

Hold it for a few seconds.
name: CHAIR GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your back straight.
Please relax your hips.
Breathe regularly.
To make a deeper stretch, pull your crossed leg closer to your body.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and glutes and can reduce your lower back pain.

introduce:

name: CHAIR GLUTE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.

introduce: Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor and your hands on your thighs.\n\nRock back and forth from your toes to your heels. Repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR HEEL TO TOE ROCK

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your feet parallel and your ankles stable.
Please pause at the top for a few seconds.
Please do it slowly.
This exercise is great for improving ankle mobility and balance.
